levels.surface: محمد بن خالد بن خلي الحمصي

notes: «- وكان أبوه خالد على قضاء حمص -» and «- وهو ابن عبد الملك العوصي -» and «- وهو ابن صالح بن حى -» are Nasa'i's glosses, left out; they name the men but are not links
«حدثنا أبي» is written as a bare relation: the father is named only in the gloss, which is not part of the chain
Anas is the Companion who describes the Prophet's ring, so he is the last link
